sections.title: Unit 29: Museums, Monuments and Cultural Memory
body: Museums and monuments keep a country's memory, and the Hungarian words for this work are long and exact. In this unit you recap forms you already know (stance adverbials, participles before a noun, contrast, purpose, scalar adverbs) and use them with the vocabulary of museums and heritage protection.
The reading is a short original text about Pulszky Ferenc, director of the National Museum from 1869 to 1894, and his memoir *Életem és korom*.
